purpose: Four independently drawn static keyframes for user review; no animation or narration audio generated in this batch.
reference_policy: Earlier images supplied only for original character identity and pixel art direction; no crop counted as a new drawing.

assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Draw ONE completely new cinematic storyboard keyframe, landscape 16:9, for the Chinese prose film 窗, cute refined strong pixel art in our chosen classic handheld RPG A style. Reference 1 is only the original brown-haired boy / green vest / white shirt / red tie / navy trousers / brown shoes identity and seated anatomy guide. Reference 2 is ONLY a palette and chibi pixel-art style reference. Do not copy or crop either image's scene. Design a truly DIFFERENT camera position.
SHOT 1, claustrophobic classroom: camera is HIGH at the FRONT blackboard end of the classroom, looking toward the BACK of the classroom. Therefore the left-window wall in the students' floor plan is on the RIGHT SIDE OF THIS REVERSE VIEW. Show the long single horizontal row of rectangular left-right sliding windows at image RIGHT, normal wall under the sill and straight tracks. The blackboard is BEHIND the camera and must not be on the far rear wall. Back wall has ordinary lockers/bookshelves and noticeboards, no second bank of windows. A one-step raised teacher platform is partly visible at bottom-left foreground ABOVE THE CAPTION BAND, with its single step down to student floor. 
Class layout: three columns of paired desks, four rows, approximately 24 students. Each paired group comprises TWO identical single desks joined side by side with an obvious seam and TWO chairs BEHIND their respective students. Students face the camera/blackboard, their own desktop is IN FRONT of their torso toward the camera, chair backs are BEHIND their backs toward the room rear. Their bodies are seated ON chair seats, knees and legs naturally under their own desks, shoes on floor, no empty chairs in front of the desks. Keep same consistent perspective for all furniture. Show narrow but believable aisles with bags tucked to chair sides, not random furniture touching bodies. Two classmates politely pass one another in one aisle, feet fully on floor, elbows gathered to avoid collision. Other students read or quietly talk. No teacher.
Original brown-haired protagonist sits at the LAST ROW paired desk beside the right-in-image window wall, on that pair's WINDOW-SIDE seat; navy-haired male deskmate occupies the adjacent INTERIOR-SIDE seat. Show the main boy as part of the seat, with chair support, not stuck in a desk seam or between rows. He glances at the window, quieter than the other small conversational groups. Use warm ochre desk/floor tones, restrained green uniforms, blue metal chairs and rainy blue window light. Crisp deliberate square-pixel clusters, compact cute chibi figures, consistent handheld-game pixel rendering, not smooth anime painting. Compose a sense of crowdedness while all foreground bodies/furniture remain readable.
Reserve bottom 20% as an OPAQUE DARK NAVY RPG subtitle panel with a fine understated pixel border. Keep the entire scene and all visible shoe contacts ABOVE this band; don't cover feet with captions. In that band, print ONLY this exact full original sentence, in LARGE BOLD easily readable white Chinese type, centered, generous padding: 主播高中的教室是狭窄逼仄的。
Use the exact word 主播 and exact rare character 仄; no paraphrase, no additional labels, scene number, title, speech bubbles, logos or watermark. This is a static inspection keyframe demonstrating real camera and action design, not a zoomed duplicate.

Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE independent newly drawn cinematic inspection keyframe, landscape 16:9, for our Chinese prose 窗 in the EXACT same cute strong square-pixel handheld RPG A art direction as the provided references. Reference 1 is the classroom's floor plan/colors/character world and must remain consistent. Reference 2 is the ORIGINAL BROWN-HAIRED PROTAGONIST identity only. Compose a brand-new shot, not a crop, enlargement, edit of the old overview.
SHOT 2: "their little worlds". Camera has moved into a classroom aisle near the front-middle of the room, lowered to the classmates' seated eye height, looking diagonally toward the BACK/WINDOW corner. The classroom's window wall remains on the RIGHT of the image in this front-to-rear view; the blackboard/teaching platform is BEHIND the camera, do NOT put the blackboard on the rear wall. The background rear wall has the same ordinary storage/book shelves/noticeboards.
In the foreground LEFT and CENTER, two distinct pairs of naturally seated classmates are quietly sharing interests at their OWN paired desks. The nearest pair, a short black-haired boy with glasses and a ponytailed girl, share an open illustrated school notebook lying on the desktop; the girl points to a small drawing and the boy leans his HEAD a little toward it, bodies remain naturally sitting on their chairs. Adjacent pair, a short-haired blue-haired girl and a softer reddish-haired boy, exchange a small book resting across the desk seam, clearly using normal attached arms and hands. Four different characters, different hairstyles, not duplicated protagonist clones. Warm small smiles and eye contact. Each pair has TWO MATCHING SINGLE DESKS side by side, clear center seam, TWO chairs directly behind their bodies; hips ON chair seats, knees under their own desks, shoes on floor. Chair backs behind the people, desk in FRONT of them. No empty chairs in front, no desk crossing anyone's waist/back, no 180-degree pelvis twists, no floating feet or hands. The camera angle must let seated support and floor shadows read naturally, foreground feet shown ABOVE the subtitle band.
Farther back at the same LAST ROW window-side seat at BACK RIGHT, the ORIGINAL boy with short spiky brown hair, green sweater vest, white shirt, red tie, navy trousers and brown shoes sits quietly with navy-haired male deskmate on his interior-side seat. Main boy is turned a little toward the rain window, remaining ON his chair behind his own desk, not in the aisle. He is separated from the warm foreground group by a strip of quiet visual space and pale rain-light; emotionally alone while surrounded by about 12 other visible small classmates receding in depth. This separation is the subject of the shot. One original protagonist only, do not duplicate his exact design in a foreground group. Horizontal sliding rectangular windows, ordinary wall below sill, wet trees outside; consistent warm wooden desks, blue metal legs/chairs, pale walls and green uniforms. Crisp restrained pixel clusters, cute small chibi anatomy, limited game palette, NOT smooth anime painting, no film grain.
Bottom 20% is the same opaque dark navy RPG subtitle band with subtle pixel border. Keep the scene, complete foreground feet and all key interactions ABOVE the band. Print ONLY the following exact complete sentence in large bold white Chinese type, centered in TWO balanced lines, linebreak after the comma:
他们围成了一个个小小世界，
讲述着我听不懂的历史。
Exact words and punctuation, no added character speech, no speech bubbles, no captions elsewhere, no titles, numbers, logos or watermark. This is a prose narration keyframe with word-for-word narration text, not invented dialogue.

Use case: illustration-story. Create a BRAND-NEW independent landscape 16:9 pixel-art keyframe of FIRST-PERSON HORIZONTAL SLIDING WINDOW OPENING, for our Chinese prose film 窗. Reference 1 and 2 are only the consistent classroom palette, pixel scale, rainy trees/school outside and the boy's uniform world. This shot must be a dedicated first-person drawing, NOT an enlargement or crop of either classroom image.
View straight OUT through one ordinary Chinese classroom wall window, at the seated boy's eye height. The entire window outer frame and sill are rigid rectangles with parallel straight edges, blue/mint metal trim, a single horizontal bank of sliding glass, normal solid wall BELOW the wooden/stone sill. Outer frame is FIXED. Four equal-width upright rectangular sashes on TWO parallel HORIZONTAL tracks: outer left and outer right stay at sides; the two inner moving sashes slide OUTWARD and overlap their respective fixed side panes. At this inspection pose the window is about halfway open, showing a clear OPEN AIR GAP at CENTER; left moving sash shifted LEFT, right moving sash shifted RIGHT. All sashes have CONSTANT width/height, no hinges, no outward swing, no bent mullions, no folding, no diagonal pane. Keep fixed top/bottom tracks aligned, include two ordinary small vertical metal pull handles attached to the moving inner sash edges.
The protagonist is not visible as a third-person character. Only TWO small anatomically coherent pixel-art hands and attached forearms extend continuously up from the lower foreground, with white shirt sleeves/cuffs matching the same boy. Left hand grips the LEFT moving sash handle at approximately 30% of image width, right hand grips the RIGHT moving sash handle at approximately 70%; hands are well separated, do not clasp at center, fingers curl around the attached handles, thumb on other side, no detached arms or extra fingers. Both wrists visibly connect to sleeves, forearms continue down to the scene bottom. The hands and gripping action are in the middle height of the image ABOVE the caption area.
Outside is the same rainy school courtyard with wet paving, leafy trees, a low school building and pale blue rainlight; sharper clear light visible through the center OPENING, subtle translucent reflections only on side GLASS. A tiny wet glint on the sill and small leaf moving inward indicate first cool air. No dramatic particles, no camera tilt, no fantasy castle. Keep polished cute classic handheld-RPG strong visible square-pixel clusters, crisp limited earthy/blue/green palette and consistent pixel scale, not a smooth digital painting. This is the emotional opening action, gentle and precise.
Reserve bottom 26% as the same OPAQUE DARK NAVY RPG subtitle band with restrained thin pixel corner border. Keep the entire handles, hands, wrist joints and window sill ABOVE the band. Print the following COMPLETE ORIGINAL SENTENCE in THREE LARGE BOLD WHITE CENTERED Chinese lines, exactly as written, no omissions or paraphrase:
意识蹒跚着爬上窗扣，肢体却得到了勇气的奖赏，
我缓缓支走那两片玻璃，天地之间唤起一片清澈的凉，
教室里面映满了雨水和露水的影子，终是把我们都接成一片了。
Verbatim important: 窗扣, 支走 (NOT 推开), 蹒跚, 肢体, 奖赏, 雨水和露水, 终是. The prose must remain spoken in full later, so reproduce every character and punctuation in the caption. Use large readable type with generous margins; no scene labels, titles, extra dialogue, speech bubbles, logos or watermark.

Use case: illustration-story. Draw ONE entirely new landscape 16:9 cinematic inspection keyframe for the prose film 窗. Keep the original cute brown-haired protagonist, green vest/white shirt/red tie/navy trousers/brown shoes and refined strong square-pixel handheld RPG A style. Reference 1 and 2 provide the SAME CLASSROOM FLOOR PLAN and identities; reference 3 provides the now OPEN horizontally sliding window and rainy courtyard. This shot has a completely DIFFERENT CAMERA POSITION from the front-facing group shots and from the first-person window shot, never crop an old composition.
SHOT 4: freedom enters the classroom. Camera is at DESK HEIGHT in the REAR AISLE near the boy's LAST ROW, looking diagonally toward the classroom FRONT. Therefore the classroom window wall is now at IMAGE LEFT, the green blackboard/raised teaching platform is far away at upper center/right. The left-wall windows are the same single horizontal bank of rectangular sliding windows, rigid parallel frames, horizontal tracks, normal wall below sill. The nearest window's two center sashes have slid left and right to overlap side panes, leaving a clear OPEN CENTRAL AIR GAP. No outward hinges or bent panes. Wet trees and the same school buildings visible outside.
Place the ORIGINAL BROWN-HAIRED BOY in the near LEFT foreground at his proper window-side seat of ONE PAIRED DESK GROUP. View him from three-quarter REAR/SIDE so his relaxed face can turn slightly left toward the open window without twisting his torso. His BODY remains seated facing classroom FRONT, thighs aligned toward his own desk, hips visibly resting on his chair SEAT, chair BACK behind his back toward the rear aisle/camera, knees beneath his own tabletop, feet grounded. The wooden desktop is in FRONT OF his body, not behind, no table through his waist, no extra empty chair between him and his own desk. Show the seat/body support and floor contact ABOVE the caption band. His shoulders have dropped, eyes gently closed or half closed, a subtle peaceful expression and relaxed arms on his desktop. A few hair tufts and white sleeve edges move in the breeze. One loose notebook page gently bends upward, still pinned by a book, not a storm of papers.
His navy-haired deskmate is STILL TEMPORARILY AWAY at this part of the original text. On the INTERIOR-SIDE (RIGHT) of their SAME pair are the deskmate's second matching desk, book, navy bag and ONE EMPTY CHAIR at its proper position BEHIND that desk, exactly where a seated body would sit. The desk center seam divides the two tabletop halves without running through the protagonist. No empty chair in FRONT of either desk. Nearest pair uses exactly two desk halves and two chairs total. At least a dozen classmates in the middle/background sit naturally at further paired desks, small restrained head turns or continued reading, attached limbs, shoes on floor. All desks face the same distant teaching front, one raised platform step and ordinary teacher desk under the green blackboard. No teacher or extra protagonist clones.
This new view looks into the SAME room, now transformed by COOL CLEAR RAINLIGHT, luminous pale cyan/blue window glints on the dry wooden floor and desks, cooler shadows, fresh green trees, gently moving hair/page indicating a new breathable feeling. Preserve warm wooden objects but change the overall mood from the cramped warm first shot to open, calm cool light. NO flooded classroom, no water on indoor floor, no glowing magic or exaggerated wind ribbons. The protagonist remains physically in the classroom; his change is emotional, not an invented escape.
Use deliberate crisp pixel clusters, cute chibi anatomy, coherent desk/chair perspective, richly designed classic handheld RPG scene, not smooth anime or photorealism. Bottom 20% reserved for the same OPAQUE DARK NAVY subtitle band with thin restrained pixel border. Put ONLY the following exact full original sentence in LARGE BOLD WHITE Chinese text, centered with generous margins:
我享受这份拥抱，因为它赞许了我们的自由。
Preserve all characters including 赞许, no rewriting, no labels, title, numbers, speech bubbles, logos or watermark. Scene and full foreground shoes must remain ABOVE the panel.
assets.edit_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct ONLY the main protagonist's LOWER LEGS AND SHOES in this pixel-art classroom keyframe. Preserve his head, brown hair, closed eyes, face, green vest, white sleeves, arms, seated hips, chair seat/back, desks, empty deskmate chair, all other characters, window, light, composition, pixel style and ALL Chinese subtitle text EXACTLY.
The near-left brown-haired protagonist currently has an erroneous extra third shoe shape around the RIGHT side of his own chair. He must have EXACTLY TWO navy trouser lower legs and EXACTLY TWO brown shoes. His hips remain on his existing chair seat, thighs face FORWARD UNDER HIS DESK toward the blackboard, knees are bent naturally, lower legs descend under his own desk. From this REAR camera angle, show the backs/heels of the two shoes resting on the floor below the chair/desk, with toes directed AWAY toward the classroom front, partly hidden by the desk if needed. Both legs belong to his single pelvis and remain inside the proper seated footprint. Remove the superfluous rightmost sideways-pointing shoe near x=750..820, y=685..745 of this 1672x941 image; the edit region is approximately x=570..830, y=610..750. The right-side deskmate chair is EMPTY, so add no feet beneath it. Keep all blue chair legs and desk legs unchanged and don't confuse them with trousers. No loose shoe, detached leg, duplicate shoe or new person. Floor contact and shadow must be clear. Two legs/two feet ONLY, correctly oriented and naturally occluded; preserving a believable seated posture is more important than displaying a full front-facing shoe from behind.
Do not alter or redraw the subtitle band or wording: 我享受这份拥抱，因为它赞许了我们的自由。 Maintain the same strong pixel clusters and image dimensions.
